overview.description: Next-generation sequencing turns biology into big data: read QC, alignment to a reference, variant calling, and RNA-seq quantification. Understanding coverage/depth, error modes, and pipelines (nf-core) is a core industry competency.
objectives: explain read depth / coverage and why it matters
run a mapping + variant-calling or RNA-seq quantification pipeline
QC reads (adapters, duplicates, quality) before calling anything
interpret a VCF and distinguish real variants from artefacts

steps.description: Next-generation sequencing turns biology into big data: read QC, alignment to a reference, variant calling, and RNA-seq quantification. Understanding coverage/depth, error modes, and pipelines (nf-core) is a core industry competency.
steps.intro: NGS analysis is a pipeline discipline: garbage-in propagates, so QC and coverage decisions upstream determine whether a downstream call is trustworthy.

instructions.title: QC the reads
instructions.description: Run FastQC/MultiQC; trim adapters and low-quality tails; check duplication and GC bias.

instructions.title: Align
instructions.description: Map to a reference (BWA/STAR); assess mapping rate and coverage uniformity.

instructions.title: Call & filter
instructions.description: Call variants or quantify expression; filter by depth/quality to remove artefacts.

instructions.title: Reproduce
instructions.description: Wrap it in a workflow (nf-core) so the whole pipeline reruns identically on new data.

submission.description: Describe how you would go from raw reads to a filtered variant call (or expression matrix), naming the QC and coverage checks that make the result trustworthy.
